source: My Hero Academia 5e Official Handbook — Ch. 4 (Equipment) and Ch. 5 (Customization & Feats)
note: Every entry in the handbook that carries a printed Yen price. Named support items (Grenadier Bracers, Full Gauntlet, Capturing Scarf, etc.) are deliberately absent: the handbook gates those by rarity and by quirk rather than by price, so they are DM-granted from the admin page, not bought. `kind` decides what a purchase does — item: adds an inventory row; part: increments a crafting-part counter; service: deducts Yen only, since a hospital stay is not a thing you carry.

items.name: Standard Ammunition (box of 50)
items.effect: Rounds for any firearm on this page. A weapon licence is still required to carry the gun.

items.name: Rubber Rounds (box of 20)
items.effect: Any firearm loaded with these deals bludgeoning damage one die size smaller (d10→d8, d8→d6, d6→d4) and is non-lethal: a creature reduced to 0 HP is knocked out, not dying.

items.name: Compound Crossbow
items.effect: Silent. Needs only a Tier I weapon licence.

items.name: Wrist-braced Slingshot
items.effect: Silent, legal, and the first weapon most hero-course kids ever owned.

items.name: Flare Gun
items.effect: The flare lights a 60-ft radius for 1 minute and can be seen two miles away at night.

items.name: Combat Knife
items.effect: Quick and stealthy.

items.name: Trench Knife
items.effect: Armor Piercing: ignores up to 2 AC from armor.

items.name: Katana
items.effect: Elegant and high damage.

items.name: Tactical Baton
items.effect: Can knock out without killing.

items.name: Tomahawk
items.effect: Throwable, dual-use weapon.

items.name: Chainsaw Blade
items.effect: Applies 1 rank of Bleed on hit.

items.name: Reinforced Hammer
items.effect: Knockback: target must make a STR save or be pushed 10 ft.

items.name: Military Pick
items.effect: Armor Piercing: deals double damage to metal armor.

items.name: Knuckle Dusters
items.effect: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 + STR, or +1 damage if your unarmed damage is already higher. Illegal to carry in public. Every Byakko Claw owns a pair.

items.name: Tekko-kagi (hand claws)
items.effect: Your unarmed strikes may deal slashing damage. Byakko's signature weapon — carrying a pair in the backstreets is a statement.

items.name: Bō Staff
items.effect: Can knock out without killing. Vault with it for +10 ft on a long jump.

items.name: Tonfa (pair)
items.effect: While you hold the pair, +1 AC against melee attacks.

items.name: Wakizashi
items.effect: A katana's little brother: no penalty for fighting in corridors, stairwells or other cramped spaces.

items.name: Kusarigama
items.effect: Reach 10 ft with the chain. On a hit, as a bonus action, trip or disarm the target (STR or DEX save, DC 8 + proficiency + DEX).

items.name: Naginata
items.effect: Reach 10 ft. When a creature enters your reach, you may use your reaction to attack it.

items.name: Kanabō (iron club)
items.effect: Double damage to objects and structures. On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

items.name: Shuriken (pack of 10)
items.effect: Half of any that miss can be recovered.

items.name: Flash Grenade
items.effect: All creatures in a 15-ft radius make a CON save or are Blinded for 1 round. Useful for ambushes.

items.name: Frag Grenade
items.effect: Creatures in a 15-ft radius make a DEX save for half damage.

items.name: Smoke Grenade
items.effect: Creates a 20-ft radius cloud that is heavily obscured for 1 minute or until dispersed. Blocks vision.

items.name: EMP Grenade
items.effect: All tech (drones, gear, lights) in a 20-ft radius is disabled for 1d4 rounds. Robots and cyborgs make a CON save or are stunned.

items.name: Dynamite
items.effect: Huge blast in a 15-ft radius; full fire damage on a hit, half on a DEX save. Fragile — can be shot or dropped.

items.name: Foam Grenade
items.effect: 10-ft radius. DEX DC 13 or restrained in hardening foam (action, STR DC 13 to break free). Non-lethal, and very popular with provisional students.

items.name: Concussion Grenade
items.effect: 10-ft radius, CON DC 12. Failure: full damage, deafened for 1 minute and knocked prone. Success: half damage only.

items.name: Ice Grenade
items.effect: 10-ft radius, DEX DC 12 for half. The area is difficult terrain for 1 minute, and anything caught in it that was stalled or overheating from its own quirk is cooled at once.

items.name: Stun Baton
items.effect: On a hit, CON DC 12 or the target cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. 20 charges; recharges overnight.

items.name: Taser Pistol
items.effect: On a hit, CON DC 12 or incapacitated until the end of the target's next turn. Metal-skinned targets save with advantage — unless they are wet, in which case they save with disadvantage.

items.name: Taser Cartridges (pair)
items.effect: Two shots for the taser pistol.

items.name: Capture Tape Launcher
items.effect: Ranged attack; on a hit the target is restrained (action, STR or DEX DC 13 to escape). Hero-grade adhesive, the same tape the pros use.

items.name: Capture Tape Cartridge
items.effect: Three more shots for the launcher.

items.name: Bolas
items.effect: Ranged attack; on a hit a Large or smaller creature's speed becomes 0 until it uses an action to free itself (STR DC 10).

items.name: Pepper Spray
items.effect: 3 uses. CON DC 12 or blinded until the end of the target's next turn. Useless against anything that does not breathe, or that has no face.

items.name: Riot Shield
items.effect: As a reaction when an adjacent ally is attacked, give them half cover.

items.name: Zip Cuffs (pack of 10)
items.effect: An action on a restrained or incapacitated creature: it stays restrained until freed (STR DC 15, or anything that cuts). Quirk-suppressant cuffs are police-only and not sold here.

items.name: Basic Part
items.effect: Suit construction. DIY suit 3 · Starter suit 5. Bought from tech shops, salvaged from scrap, or taken from villain tech.

items.name: Pro Part
items.effect: Suit construction. Pro suit 6 · Elite suit 8 · Prototype 10. Earned on special missions or bought from black-market dealers.

items.name: Advanced Mod
items.effect: Suit construction. Prototype suit 5. Rare drops, quest rewards, government labs, elite sponsorships.

items.name: Basic Tech Part
items.effect: Support-item construction. Basic Gadget 2 · Enhanced Gear 4.

items.name: Advanced Part
items.effect: Support-item construction. Advanced Tool 4 · Elite Device 6 · Prototype Tech 8.

items.name: Unique Mod
items.effect: Support-item construction. Boss drops, black market, or special quest rewards.

items.name: E — Homemade Gear
items.effect: Makeshift suits cobbled from scraps; functional but limited customization.

items.name: D — Budget Hero Gear
items.effect: Outdated nylon and metal plating; bulky but offers basic protection.

items.name: D — Salvage Solutions
items.effect: Recycled parts and jury-rigged electronics; moderately reliable with some enhancements.

items.name: C — Costume Co.
items.effect: Clunky but durable suits; traditional design for steady protection.

items.name: C — Alloy Armory
items.effect: Sturdy suits with light armor plating and reinforced joints; popular for patrols and guards.

items.name: B — QuirkWear Studio
items.effect: Sleek, sportswear-inspired with flair; balances style and function for rising heroes.

items.name: B — Flux Tek
items.effect: Lightweight tech suits focused on energy channeling and moderate protection.

items.name: A — HeroForge Tokyo
items.effect: Futuristic armor with powered joints, HUDs, and agility enhancements.

items.name: S — Jeanist Atelier
items.effect: Stylish, durable denim-weave suits maximizing quirk flow and comfort; elite craftsmanship. Handbook lists ¥250,000+ — adjust the price for bespoke work.

items.name: F — Homemade / Self-Made
items.effect: Basic DIY suits with no built-in enhancements. School-issued at no charge.

items.name: E — Street Gear / Budget
items.effect: Simple gear with minimal protection; includes one minor perk. School-issued at no charge.

items.name: D — Seiai Academy Basic
items.effect: Clean but low-defense suits with one basic perk. School-issued at no charge.

items.name: C- — Ketsubutsu Budget
items.effect: Bulkier, more durable budget suits; still limited perks. School-issued at no charge.

items.name: C+ — Shiketsu Custom
items.effect: Stylish and minimalist suits with some defensive perks. School-issued at no charge.

items.name: B — Ketsubutsu Enhanced
items.effect: Enhanced materials and sensor integrations. School-issued at no charge.

items.name: A- — U.A. Basic Suit
items.effect: Battle-tested, ergonomic design with multiple minor perks. School-issued at no charge.

items.name: A — U.A. Modular Suit
items.effect: Modular suit with utility slots and advanced tech features. School-issued at no charge.

items.name: Standard Hero Medkit
items.effect: Bonus action: stabilize a downed ally with no check. Action: restore 2d4 HP using two charges and clear 2 ranks of Bleed (once per target per rest). One-use defibrillator: an unconscious creature makes a DC 10 CON save to regain 1 HP and consciousness, or is stabilized on a failure. Charges are restored on a long rest if medical supplies are available.

items.name: Scholar's Pack
items.effect: A notebook, 5 empty journals, writing utensils, a recording device, 5 days of field rations, and a thermos.

items.name: Grapple-line Launcher
items.effect: Bonus action: fire a 60-ft line that anchors to any solid surface. Your movement can reel you up to 60 ft along it, straight up included.

items.name: Comms Earpieces (pair)
items.effect: Encrypted, 1-mile range. They do not work through heavy shielding: refrigerant-lined walls, lead, or deep underground.

items.name: Night-vision Goggles
items.effect: Darkvision 60 ft while worn. A sudden bright light — a flare, a beam — blinds you until the end of your next turn.

items.name: Thermal Goggles
items.effect: See heat through up to 1 ft of wall or smoke within 60 ft. Anything with no body heat shows as nothing at all.

items.name: Climbing Gloves
items.effect: Climbing speed equal to half your walking speed.

items.name: Rebreather Mask
items.effect: 10 minutes of air. Advantage on saves against gas, smoke and spores.

items.name: Body Camera
items.effect: Records 12 hours of video. Evidence, protection, and documentation.

items.name: Pocket Drone
items.effect: Scout up to 300 ft away for 10 minutes; you see what it sees. AC 13, 5 HP. TECH DC 12 to fly it through a tight gap.

items.name: Hydration Pack
items.effect: Three litres on your back. Advantage on saves against dehydration, and on any check where your quirk depends on water.

items.name: First-aid Pouch
items.effect: 2 charges. Action: restore 1d4+1 HP and clear 1 rank of Bleed.

items.name: Weighted Training Vest
items.effect: Wear it through a free-time training slot for advantage on that slot's check.

items.name: Portable Speaker
items.effect: No mechanical effect. Kinji will want to borrow it and will not give it back.

items.name: Simple Meal
items.effect: Basic food, sufficient for one person to regain energy.

items.name: Fancy Meal
items.effect: Higher quality meal, often found in restaurants or hero lounges.

items.name: Deluxe Meal
items.effect: Gourmet meal with added benefits like buffs or morale boosts.

items.name: Inn — Basic
items.effect: Basic lodging with minimal amenities, common in small towns.

items.name: Inn — Comfortable
items.effect: Mid-tier accommodation with better comfort and security.

items.name: Inn — Luxurious
items.effect: High-end lodging with premium services and privacy.

items.name: Camping Supplies
items.effect: Gear for outdoor survival, including tents and cooking tools.

items.name: Travel Rations
items.effect: Portable food for one day, ideal for long journeys or missions.

items.name: Travel Pack
items.effect: Standard adventurer's pack with essential supplies for multi-day trips. Includes rations.

items.name: Hot Springs Visit
items.effect: Access to a hot spring, useful for healing and stress relief.

items.name: Personal Butler
items.effect: Servant to assist with daily tasks and personal needs.

items.name: Personal Chef
items.effect: Custom meal preparation tailored to dietary or Quirk needs.

items.name: Karaoke Booth
items.effect: Kinji will take the microphone.

items.name: Arcade Tokens
items.effect: Twenty goes on anything in the building.

items.name: Public Bathhouse
items.effect: Clears one rank of exhaustion. Some bathhouses have very interesting regulars.

items.name: Tokyo Day Pass
items.effect: Every train and subway line in the city for one day.

items.name: Batting Cage (Swing Town)
items.effect: Run by a very large, very gentle young man with two stripes on his arm.

items.name: Cinema Ticket
items.effect: Kinji and Ando will talk through the whole film.

items.name: Cat Café
items.effect: A cat will sit on whoever is most stressed.

items.name: Yukata Rental
items.effect: For summer festivals and fireworks.

items.name: Tokyo Dome Ticket
items.effect: Unless Ichitaka invites you to his family's private box, which is free.

items.name: Hero License Exam (Initial)
items.effect: Required to legally act as a hero; includes testing, evaluation, and ID.

items.name: Provisional License Renewal
items.effect: Annual fee to maintain provisional hero status.

items.name: Full Hero License Renewal
items.effect: Annual renewal for full-fledged heroes.

items.name: Weapon License (Tier I–III)
items.effect: Required to carry and use specialized or offensive equipment in public.

items.name: Support Gear Registration
items.effect: Registers official hero tech, suits, and support items with the government.

items.name: Vigilante Pardon Application
items.effect: Fee to apply for legal status or amnesty for unauthorized heroic actions.

items.name: Legal Representation
items.effect: Defense for legal disputes, hero misconduct, or Quirk liability issues.

items.name: Public Liability Coverage
items.effect: Insurance against damages caused during sanctioned hero work.

items.name: Quirk Registry Access
items.effect: Official access to classified Quirk data (heroes, villains, or researchers).

items.name: ID Replacement Fee
items.effect: Fee to replace a lost or damaged hero/villain identification card.

items.name: Hospital Stay (Standard)
items.effect: Daily cost for injury recovery or post-mission treatment.

items.name: Quirk-Induced Trauma Care
items.effect: Specialized healing for internal or cellular Quirk damage.

items.name: Emergency Surgery
items.effect: Critical injury treatment, often for severe or life-threatening wounds.

items.name: Psychological Counseling
items.effect: Required after traumatic missions or prolonged conflict.

items.name: Therapy Pet Certification
items.effect: Official approval and registration of a support animal for field use.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.effect: Bonus action: 1d4 temporary HP. A third one inside an hour: CON DC 12 or gain a rank of Queasy.

items.name: Protein Bar
items.effect: Eaten during a short rest: regain 2 extra HP. Forge eats forty a day.

items.name: Smelling Salts
items.effect: Action: wake an unconscious creature that is not dying, or clear 1 rank of Concussed.

items.name: Burn Gel
items.effect: 2 uses. Action: clear 1 rank of Burned.

items.name: Coagulant Spray
items.effect: 2 uses. Action: clear 2 ranks of Bleed.

items.name: Adrenaline Auto-injector
items.effect: Single use. Action on a creature at 0 HP: it regains 1 + its CON modifier HP and stands up. After the fight it gains a level of exhaustion.

items.name: Cooling Spray
items.effect: 3 uses. Action on a creature you can touch: end a stall, overheat or burn-out caused by its own quirk.

items.name: Instant Ice Pack
items.effect: Single use. As cooling spray, once.

items.name: Earplugs
items.effect: While worn you are deafened, and immune to any effect that requires you to hear it.

items.name: Elite School Application
items.effect: Entrance fee for U.A., Ketsubutsu, Shiketsu, or equivalent institutions.

items.name: Entrance Exam / Retake
items.effect: Required after failing a school's initial exam.

items.name: Fitness & Quirk Evaluation
items.effect: Basic physical and Quirk capability testing for ranking and placement.

items.name: Custom Training Plan
items.effect: A personalized regimen designed to develop Quirk efficiency and combat skill.

items.name: Mentorship Program
items.effect: One-on-one coaching from licensed pro heroes or villains.

items.name: PR Campaign
items.effect: Professional branding for reputation repair or hero image boosting.

items.name: Media Interview Slot
items.effect: Book time with a major network; includes prep and editing.

items.name: Scandal Control Package
items.effect: Crisis PR to cover up or spin controversial incidents.

items.name: Private Investigator Hire
items.effect: Surveillance, intel-gathering, or tracking targets.

items.name: Black Market Info Access
items.effect: Unofficial access to classified or illegal data.

items.name: Villain Safehouse Rental
items.effect: Hidden and secure locations to avoid detection.

items.name: Underground Tournament Fee
items.effect: Entry into unregulated fighting arenas for cash or reputation.

items.name: Byakko Safe-passage Token
items.effect: For one free-time window, Strays and Claws leave you alone. Fangs and above do not care what you paid.

items.name: Van, No Questions Asked
items.effect: A white van from Byakko's chop shop: clean plates, no paperwork. The last one went to a man with a scar who bled on the counter.
